name: agent-watch
description: Live view of Claude Code sessions and the agents they spawn.

agentWatch.projectsDir.description: Override the Claude Code projects directory. Empty resolves CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, then ~/.claude/projects.

agentWatch.liveWindowSeconds.description: A session whose transcript was written within this many seconds counts as live.

agentWatch.recentDays.description: Only sessions touched within this many days are listed.

agentWatch.maxSessionsPerRepo.description: Most recent sessions to load per repo.

agentWatch.pollSeconds.description: How often to re-stat watched transcripts. This poll is what guarantees updates; native file watching is only an accelerator.

agentWatch.statusBarPriority.description: Status bar priority. Higher numbers sit further left within the right-hand group. The default clears claude-usage, which spans 50-101 at its own default priority.

agentWatch.initialDepth.description: How many levels below each session are expanded on first render. 0 shows sessions alone; 1 adds their workflow runs and agents. Deeper levels start collapsed and expand on click.

agentWatch.zoomSensitivity.description: Multiplier for scroll-wheel zoom. Lower is gentler; 0 disables wheel zoom and leaves the +/- and Fit controls.

agentWatch.hideDeletedWork.description: Hide work you have already cleaned up: sessions whose git worktree or branch no longer exists, and project directories that are not inside a git repository. The status line reports how many were hidden.
